headline: GI PackTech: international lead generation and an export sales engine for an industrial packaging maker.
summary: International lead-generation campaigns across markets worldwide, a website gaa-tha built and manages, a full product catalogue, AI product imagery for 41 products and Google Business Profile for GI PackTech.
answer: gaa-tha runs international marketing for GI PackTech, an Indian maker of VCI films, vacuum laminates, machine covers and reactor liners. We run its lead-generation campaigns for buyers around the world on LinkedIn and Meta, built and manage its website, and produced its product catalogue, brochures and AI product imagery.
channels: LinkedIn, Meta, website, catalogue, Google Business Profile
challenge: GI PackTech makes specialised industrial packaging — VCI films, vacuum laminates, machine covers, reactor liners and more. The products are technical, the buyers are international, and there was no material that explained each product clearly enough for an overseas buyer to act on.
The company needed a partner to explain the range, build the website buyers check first, and then run international lead generation month after month — not a single campaign.

workstreams.title: International lead-generation campaigns
workstreams.text: Campaigns for buyers across the world on LinkedIn and Meta, a 50-company Sales Navigator outreach tracker with curated message sequences, and a marketing playbook for both channels — with leads qualified before they reach the sales team.

workstreams.title: Website — built and managed
workstreams.text: We built and manage GI PackTech's website with product pages, applications and enquiry routes for international buyers, plus AI-produced hero imagery.

workstreams.title: Product catalogue and brochures
workstreams.text: A full catalogue with product explanations, applications, customisation options and sales guidance for each line, and product-specific brochures such as the flexible reactor liner brochure.

workstreams.title: AI product imagery
workstreams.text: 110 AI image prompts across 41 products for the catalogue and website — consistent product visuals without a 41-product photoshoot.

workstreams.title: Local SEO
workstreams.text: Google Business Profile content so domestic buyers searching for packaging suppliers find a complete, current profile.

results: GI PackTech now has a website, catalogue and image library an international buyer can act on, and a lead-generation engine that runs every month. International leads, countries reached, meetings booked and RFQs are published once confirmed from the outreach tracker.

faq.q: Who runs GI PackTech's international marketing?
faq.a: gaa-tha runs GI PackTech's international lead-generation campaigns on LinkedIn and Meta, and built and manages its website, catalogue and product imagery.

faq.q: How does gaa-tha generate export leads for Indian manufacturers?
faq.a: We build the material buyers expect — website, catalogue, brochures — then run LinkedIn outreach and ads plus Meta lead campaigns by market, and qualify every lead in a shared tracker.
